slides.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
bullets: Works for interviews, portraits, and narrative

slides.heading: BASIC LAYOUT
slides.caption: Key at 45°, fill opposite, backlight behind subject.

slides.heading: HOW TO SET IT UP
steps: Place key light at a 45° angle to the subject.
Add fill on the opposite side to control contrast.
Add backlight behind the subject for separation.
Adjust intensities to match the mood.

slides.heading: PRO TIP
slides.text: Use negative fill instead of more lights when you want drama.
